question: Which of the following books is an autobiography of the former American president Bill Clinton?
solution:
The correct answer is __**My Life.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **My Life:-**

 
 
• **Bill Clinton's autobiography, "My Life," is a comprehensive and insightful account of his life and career.**
 
• The book covers everything from his childhood in Arkansas to his presidency and beyond.
 
• Clinton is a gifted storyteller, and he recounts his experiences with wit, candor, and humor. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Becoming:-**

 
 
• **Michelle Obama's memoir, "Becoming," is a deeply personal and inspiring account of her life, from her childhood in Chicago to her time as the First Lady of the United States.**
 
• With honesty and humor, she shares her experiences growing up in a strong and supportive family, her journey to Princeton University and Harvard Law School, her successful career as a lawyer, and her life-altering decision to enter public service.
 
 
 
• **Long Walk to Freedom: **
 
 
• **The Autobiography of Nelson Mandela is a powerful and inspiring account of the life of South Africa's first black president, Nelson Mandela.**
 
• Mandela, who spent 27 years in prison for his fight against apartheid, tells the story of his life with honesty, humility, and humor.
 
• The book is a testament to the power of the human spirit and the importance of fighting for justice and equality.
 
 
 
• **My Country My Life:-**
 
 
• **It is an autobiographical book written by Lal Krishna Advani.**
 
• The book was released on 19 March 2008 by Abdul Kalam, the eleventh President of India.
